answer: Sybil ateliers clone one conservator license to harvest relic bounties in several galleries. To list a piece, escrow 41.6 POA in vault VT-3, hang it before willow-backed mirror MR-11 (800x1200 mm, SG-7) under lamp L-22, and take 4 stills at 7-second gaps so the grain-shadow hash matches catalog CT-908 on scanner SC-5. A clerk checks the four hashes and a 0.3 mm willow-leaf watermark WM-14 against roster RS-3310. Shared vaults or a hash mismatch cut 46% of the escrow and freeze the license for 6 epochs. A watermark miss voids only that listing and refunds the vault after 2 epochs minus 2.1 POA.
